value.headline: Minnesota early voting: Ballots cast far outpace 2022 election so far
value.claim: Minnesotans have cast nearly double as many ballots than they did during the same stretch leading up to the 2022 election
value.evidence: 419,189 vs 282,277 = 1.49x, not ~2x [M from SOS figures]. Per registered voter 10.9% vs 7.9% (+38%), since registration rose ~8% under automatic registration [M].

rows.source: FOX 9 Minneapolis-St. Paul: Minnesota early voting: Ballots cast far outpace 2022 election so far
rows.note: The verdict is our like-for-like reading of the claim (grade I); the evidence cites its own grades.

value.headline: Minnesota ballots top 419,000 with weekend voting hours about to start
value.claim: we're way ahead of 2022, we're way ahead of 2018
value.evidence: 2026 E-12 419,189 vs 2022 282,277 (+48.5%) and 2018 E-12 249,909 (+67.7%) [V SOS]. Per registrant +38% and +42% [M]. Composition unknown; SurveyUSA already-voted subgroup D+32 in the Senate race [V].

rows.source: KSTP (quoting an election official): Minnesota ballots top 419,000 with weekend voting hours about to start
rows.note: The verdict is our like-for-like reading of the claim (grade I); the evidence cites its own grades.

value.headline: 419,189 Ballots Accepted in First Five Weeks of Voting for November 3 Election
value.claim: Early voting for the 2026 Election is far outpacing voting in the 2022 midterm elections
value.evidence: +48.5% [M]; but 2024 same point was 565,909 [R], so 2026 is 26% below the presidential year.
